## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 26, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Raquel Gil_, Jun 26, 2026, 2/5: "Great, they screwed up the app with the obligatory announcement and having to wait 30 seconds, I'm not saying it's bad but I can't chat well, it jumps every 7 MESSAGES, fix it. Besides, it's full of errors and glitches, when you spend a little time talking to the bot it says RANDOM words and the character barely speaks, a shame, I liked it better before, that's why the 2 stars. Besides, it is full of Bugs that take you out of the app and the language changes or does not understand you, it is very ugly 🙃"
            2. _Sergio Rivera Aviles_, Aug 2, 2026, 3/5: "this is getting 3 stars because of too much ads and you have to pay to keep the ai memory for longer and has caused me mental issues at the point that I couldn't sleep well and kept thinking, it is a geat app but be careful and manage your talking hours a bit and try not spending all of your day talking"
            3. _Elias Partys_, Aug 2, 2026, 3/5: "okay i was loving this app for awhile, but there are SOOO many bugs. advertisements are fine, I get they have to make money somehow, but each ad makes you click into the play store EVERY TIME. and each time it goes to the play store it closes out zeta, and when I go back to zeta it doesn't register that I actually watched the advertisement so I end up having to watch about five before I can actually chat again... it's super annoying and really disappointing"
<!--/ir-theme-->
